I am 76 years old and I learned farming from my father and mother, not from any school. This small plot is only a piece of my land, so I will dig in manure from my oxen and weed it by hand with my sons; I will not buy chemical fertilizer here because one bag is too much for this little ground and my teff needs the money more. We will work this plot ourselves for about 30 days this season, and I will not pay for outside labor because my family can still handle it.
